item.title: Bunnie Xo Memoir Returns to Bestsellers Charts on Heels of Jelly Roll Split
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends. Today, we're talking about Bunnie Xo's memoir, "Stripped Down: Unfiltered and Unapologetic", which has returned to the top of the charts after her recent split from husband Jelly Roll.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: Released on February 17th, "Stripped Down" quickly became a bestseller, thanks to its raw and revealing anecdotes about Bunnie's life, from her work in the sex industry to her marriage to Jelly Roll. The book is a modern-day rags-to-riches story, showcasing Bunnie's triumph against all odds.
[Audio clip of Bunnie's interview plays]
Host: As Bunnie said in an interview, "Stripped Down is the rawest reflection of who I am in every form. It felt only fitting to name my book after the way I've always lived life — raw, unfiltered and in my naked truth."
[Soft music continues]
Host: The memoir is known for its wit and intensity, tackling dark topics with humor and self-awareness. According to Amazon, the book is "cold, clear evidence that no one is irredeemable", offering a journey of redemption and homespun wisdom.
[Audio clip of book synopsis plays]
Host: The book's cover is a reflection of Bunnie's time in the sex-work industry, where she stands topless, bearing her truth both physically and emotionally. This stint, Bunnie says, allowed her to "reclaim her power" after struggling with addiction and abuse as a teenager.
[Soft music transitions to a slightly more upbeat tone]
Host: Fast forward, and Bunnie has built an empire around Dumb Blonde Productions, creating a successful podcast with thousands of monthly listeners. And, if you're interested in checking out her memoir, there's a great deal on the audiobook version right now.
[Audio clip of deal announcement plays]
Host: You can get the audiobook version of "Stripped Down" with a new Amazon deal that gets you three months of access to audiobook streamer Audible for just $0.99 a month.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
